title.en: Build Course Listening answers in the target language
title.zh: 让课程听力用目标语言词块还原原句

purpose.en: Correct signed-in Course Listening so learners hear a target-language sentence and rebuild that same sentence from target-language word tiles, matching the real-user acceptance contract.
purpose.zh: 修正登录后课程听力：学习者听到目标语言句子，并用目标语言词块还原同一句子，使实际用户流程符合验收契约。

en: Keep the target-language sentence hidden while normal-speed and slow-speed playback remain available.
Present target-language tiles for Course Listening and preserve translated-interface prompts for Course Writing.
Grade Listening server-side against the immutable target sentence reconstructed from the official daily round.
zh: 继续隐藏目标语言句子，同时保留正常速度与慢速播放。
课程听力提供目标语言词块；课程写作继续使用界面语言提示和目标语言词块。
服务器从官方每日题组重建不可变目标句，并据此评分听力答案。

en: Signed-in Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced Course Listening and the shared sentence-builder copy for all twelve learning languages.
zh: 全部十二种学习语言的登录用户初级、中级、高级课程听力，以及共享组句组件文案。

en: Generate Listening answer tokens from targetSentence instead of its interface-language translation.
Set Course Listening source and answer language metadata to the selected target language while leaving cross-language Sprint plans unchanged.
Add regression assertions for target-language token generation and target-sentence grading.
zh: 听力答案词块改由 targetSentence 生成，不再来自界面语言翻译。
课程听力的来源与答案语言元数据均设为所选目标语言，同时不改变跨语言今日速成计划。
新增目标语言词块生成与目标句评分的回归断言。

en: Production build, sensitive-data scan, Worker artifact validation, TypeScript, all 352 automated tests, and all 62 tracked D1 migrations passed.
Shared policy, architecture, base-feature, and eleven SmartLingo contracts passed; WebKit verified 260/260 combinations across 26 routes, two interface languages, and five viewports.
Production Chrome acceptance will repeat the failed English Listening step and verify prompt direction, target-language tiles, feedback, counter advancement, and persisted learning evidence.
zh: 生产构建、敏感信息扫描、Worker 产物校验、TypeScript、全部 352 项自动化测试及全部 62 个受跟踪 D1 迁移均通过。
共享规则、架构、基础功能及 SmartLingo 十一个共享合约通过；WebKit 在 26 条路由、两种界面语言与五种视口的 260/260 组合中通过。
生产 Chrome 验收将重做失败的英语听力步骤，并核对提示方向、目标语言词块、反馈、题号推进及持久学习记录。

en: Microphone-dependent speaking remains subject to the real Chrome device permission and available audio input during the continuing 21-day QA run.
zh: 依赖麦克风的口语练习仍取决于本次 21 天 QA 继续执行时真实 Chrome 的设备权限与可用音频输入。

en: Preserve SmartLingo's Chinese interface, Clerk-linked learner identity, official 4,320-sentence catalog, signed-in progress ownership, and existing Sprint cross-language behavior.
No other portfolio site, database binding, credential, payment, referral, certificate, reward, or leaderboard resource is changed.
zh: 保持 SmartLingo 中文界面、Clerk 关联学习者身份、官方 4,320 句目录、登录进度归属及现有今日速成跨语言行为。
不修改其他组合站点、数据库绑定、凭据、支付、推荐、证书、奖励或排行榜资源。
